description_en: Decrypts a certificate in a certificate repository
description_zh: 本接口一般用于证书仓库中证书解密
name: Decrypt

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the certificate. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455806.html operation.
The identifier of an SSL certificate is typically in the {Certificate ID}-cn-hangzhou format.
The identifier of a PCA certificate is the Identifier field of the corresponding private certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书唯一识别码。该参数可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455806.html获取。
SSL证书识别码一般为{证书ID}-cn-hangzhou。
PCA证书为对应私有证书的Identifier字段
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The encryption algorithm. Valid values:

RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1
RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256
SM2PKE
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法，取值：

RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1
RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256
SM2PKE
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The data to be decrypted. The data is Base64-encoded
parameters.name: ciphertext_blob

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:

RAW: The plaintext result encoded in UTF-8 is returned.
Base64: The Base64-encoded result is returned. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
消息类型。取值：

RAW：返回结果为UTF-8编码的原文。
Base64（默认值）：返回结果为Base64加密之后的结果
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.help_en: The custom user identifier, which is a unique key
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键
parameters.name: custom_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The repository ID.
You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
仓库ID。
此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html获取
parameters.name: warehouse_id

CertIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate
